abort.single_instance_allowed: Scene Setter is already set up. Open it from the sidebar.

user.title: Scene Setter
user.description: Save a room's lights and blinds, as they are now, as a named scene. There is nothing to fill in: the rooms are your Home Assistant areas, and each room saves the lights and blinds in its area.

save.name: Save a room as a scene
save.description: Saves the room's lights and blinds, as they are now, as a scene. A scene of the same name in that room is saved over.

area_id.name: Room
area_id.description: The area to save. Not needed when a scene to save over is given.

name.name: Name
name.description: What to call the scene in its room, such as Evening. Not needed when saving over a scene.

scene.name: Scene to save over
scene.description: Optional. Save the room as it is now over this scene, keeping its name unless a name is given.

rename.name: Rename a scene
rename.description: Changes a scene's name. Its entity ID stays the same, so anything that turns the scene on keeps working.

name.name: New name
name.description: The scene's new name in its room.

delete.name: Delete a scene
delete.description: Deletes a scene made in Home Assistant.

create.name: Create a scene from a brightness level
create.description: Makes a scene that sets every light in the room to one brightness and one white, without turning anything on now. Lights with colour get the white, a running effect is stopped, and blinds are left out. A room that already has a scene of that name keeps it unless Replace is on.

name.name: Name
name.description: What to call the scene in its room, such as Dimmed.

brightness.name: Brightness
brightness.description: The brightness for every light, in percent. 0 is off. A light that can't dim is on from 50 % up.

area_id.name: Rooms
area_id.description: Optional. The rooms to make it for. Leave empty for every room with lights.

levels.name: Own levels
levels.description: Optional. Lights that get their own brightness: each light with its percent, such as light.desk_lamp: 30.

replace.name: Replace
replace.description: Save over a scene of the same name in the room.

color_temp_kelvin.name: White
color_temp_kelvin.description: The white for every light with colour, in kelvin: 2700 (warm white) unless you choose another. Lights that only do colours get the nearest colour.

init.title: Scene Setter
init.description: Rooms, and what each one saves, are set on the Scene Setter page.

data.no_apostrophes_in_ids: Leave apostrophes out of new scene entity IDs

data_description.no_apostrophes_in_ids: On: "Oli's Office Dim" gets the entity ID scene.olis_office_dim. Off: Home Assistant's usual scene.oli_s_office_dim. The name you see keeps its apostrophe either way, and scenes already saved keep their entity IDs.
